Multicomponent alloy ingots were prepared by arc melting the mixture of pure Co, Fe, Ni, Cr and Mo metals with purities above 99.8 mass% and crystal B metalloid with a purity of 99.9 mass% in an argon atmosphere.
Alloy ribbons with a cross section of about 0.025 * 1.0 mm2 were also prepared by the melt spinning method.
